nodes.description: Public total token supply, written in the constructor and inherited from EIP20Interface.
Mapping(address => uint256) of token balances; mutated by the constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of allowances; mutated by transferFrom and approve.
Human readable token name set once in the constructor.
Number of decimals used for display, set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant 2**256-1 used by transferFrom to decide whether to decrement the allowance.
Constructor: mints the initial amount to msg.sender and sets name, decimals and symbol.
Moves _value tokens from msg.sender to _to; performs unchecked balance addition and subtraction.
Moves _value tokens from _from to _to using an allowance from msg.sender; performs unchecked arithmetic.
Read-only getter returning balances[_owner].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without checking the current allowance.
Read-only getter returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Caller-controlled address used as balance key, allowance owner and minting destination.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value in transfer: unchecked subtraction (arithmetic risk, only a require guard).
balances[_to] += _value in transfer: unchecked addition to a caller-supplied address.
balances[_to] += _value in transferFrom: unchecked addition to a caller-supplied address.
balances[_from] -= _value in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction guarded only by a require.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom: allowance decrement performed inside an if (allowance < MAX_UINT256) branch.

edges.reason: Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = _initialAmount, storing attacker-supplied value into the balances mapping.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _initialAmount.
Constructor sets name = _tokenName.
Constructor sets decimals = _decimalUnits.
Constructor sets symbol = _tokenSymbol.
msg.sender is used as the mapping key that receives the initial minted balance in the constructor.
transfer executes the unchecked subtraction of the sender balance.
transfer executes the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
Parameter _value flows directly into balances[msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction result is written back into the balances state variable.
Recipient parameter _to is used as the key of the credited balance entry.
Parameter _value flows into balances[_to] += _value without SafeMath, allowing balance overflow.
Unchecked addition result is written back into the balances state variable.
msg.sender selects whose balance is debited in transfer, so the caller controls the arithmetic operand source.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction from the source balance.
transferFrom executes the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
transferFrom conditionally executes the allowance decrement statement.
Parameter _value flows into balances[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction result is written back into the balances state variable.
Parameter _from selects the balance entry that is debited in transferFrom.
Parameter _to selects the balance entry that is credited in transferFrom.
Parameter _value flows into balances[_to] += _value without SafeMath, allowing balance overflow.
Unchecked addition result is written back into the balances state variable.
Parameter _from indexes the allowed mapping to read the spender allowance.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when reading and decrementing allowed[_from][msg.sender].
allowed[_from][msg.sender] is copied into the local variable allowance.
The local allowance value guards the conditional branch that performs the allowance decrement.
Parameter _value is subtracted from the stored allowance without SafeMath.
Unchecked allowance subtraction is written back into the allowed state variable.
MAX_UINT256 is compared with allowance to decide whether the decrement branch is taken.
balanceOf returns balances[_owner], reading the state variable with a caller-supplied key.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] using the spender parameter as a key.
approve writes _value into the allowed mapping without any check on the previous allowance.
allowance reads allowed[_owner][...] using the owner parameter as a key.
allowance reads allowed[...][_spender] using the spender parameter as a key.
